notes.title: Return to campus launches TapTap test; Campus Fantasy crowdfunding campaign be！
notes.content:
1.“Campus Fantasy” will officially launch in June!
The game will include a “Rich Kid” storyline, romance routes, a series of exciting dramatic plots, and more diverse gameplay elements. On June 9, it will also participate in Steam Next Fest with a demo version. Everyone is welcome to try it out—don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380110/_/

2.The mobile version of “Return to campusl” is coming to TapTap on May 1!
This will be the first test with a limited number of 5,000 participants. If you’re interested, you can sign up for the test on TapTap.

3.For the upcoming launch of “Campus Fantasy,” I’m planning to release some fun merchandise through crowdfunding.
For more details, check out
https://afdian.com/p/52e1f6fc240d11f0b9445254001e7c00

notes.title: Urgent update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the home ground disappeared after the update
Fixed restaurant model disappearing
Fixed an issue where catching thieves would occasionally not trigger
Optimized lighting quality, there is now less noise

notes.title: Major update！
notes.content:
Upgraded the underlying rendering system and refactored the code for better performance.
Unlimited framerate has been unlocked for 40+ graphics cards, and DLSS4 is now supported for up to 4x frame interpolation.
Upgraded the underlying code of the Unreal 5 engine, now the light tracing system lumen can refresh at 60 fps with better efficiency.
Supported megalight for complex light scenes, which supports stacking of a large number of moving light sources, and improved frame rate for complex light scenes.
Optimized the situation that the new school will fail to get out of the jam.
Optimized some episodes that can't be skipped

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Daily Update
notes.content:
Added the function of summoning airplane in mobile app
When going to a new school the main quest will prompt in advance to use the first startup item in chapter 3 or it will be laggy
Fixed the problem that keyboard input cannot be enabled if the hard disk is loaded too fast.
Fixed the problem that diarrhea will cause third person when climbing walls.
Optimized the automatic loading of the archive when you skip after being fired.
Optimized the toilet issue by lowering the trigger threshold for going to the toilet, now it's over 40 for peeing and over 60 for pooping.
Added a logo for auto archive
Removed some incorrectly placed models
Added teleportation hints, when teleporting, it will prompt some basic operations.
Extended the expulsion time to allow more time to contact the director of education to clear the record.
Optimized the problem that when flying from school to city, clicking on the city map can't teleport.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Daily Updates
notes.content:
Added vehicle summoning function, now you can open your phone and click on the vehicle app to summon the vehicle
Optimized the game package again, reducing the size by 1g.
Fixed the bug that climbing being attacked would cause third person bugs
Changed the price of the Planner's Urn to $300,000
Fixed the bug that endurance increase only needs to be increased by holding shift and not pressing W to run.
Fixed the bug that pressing climb or jump during the animation will cause the character to go bald.
Optimized the Legendary Captain Marker issue, now the marker is in an open area, making it easier for the helicopter to stop
Fixed the problem of climbing occasionally going over walls
Fixed a material issue with the pants of the childhood friend
Optimized the icon of pressing F after catching the thief to white, to prevent the black icon from being invisible when doing this episode at night, which leads to stuck episodes.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: General updates
notes.content:
The game package body has been greatly optimized, reducing the footprint of 10G
Fixed an issue where shadows were incorrect in medium quality
Fixed gym clipping issues
Fixed pool lighting issues
Fixed an issue where you would fall to death after full Constitution
Fixed an issue where there was a chance that falling to death could fall to the ground
Improved tooltips for skipping episodes (will end this chapter or subsequent quests early)
Fixed a bug where stealing could quickly enter the property to evade security
Optimized the issue of returning to the initial screen after failure (now auto-read, auto-save will not return to the initial screen)
Fixed an issue where NPCs would not chase you after attacking after being beaten
Fixed clipping of dropped items after NPCs died

notes.title: Major update！
notes.content:
One. Optimized the game performance, and added the driver version judgment, game lag, driver update can be watched in this tutorial: https://youtu.be/vO6beLj4T58
1. Changed the mechanism of hitting people by driving, now the vehicle can hit passers-by without being fired, but you need to compensate $50,000 for the fee, and the vehicle cannot crash into the security guard, otherwise you will be fired
2. Fixed the issue that NPCs sat on the same bench repeatedly during class
3. Fixed the problem that the master bedroom of the 100w house could not sleep
4. Fixed the wrong problem of inviting green plum pictures to the house
5. Fixed the corpse of NPC corpses moving after death
6. Fixed the bug that the little black computer can be refreshed infinitely
7. Optimized the love event, I believe that after Xiao Hei, the main plot is no longer for my sister 300,000
8. Fixed the bug that you can infinitely farm stamina in water
9. Optimized the display of the main character's picture after wearing a hood and putting on clothes
10. Add guidelines and tips for decryption games and horror games
11. Fixed an issue where NPCs would sometimes clip into the floor
12. Fixed the issue that NIS sometimes cannot be changed
13. Fixed the punctuation issue of the legendary captain
14. Optimized the task punctuation position, now the task punctuation is in the screen in real time, and you can better find the position according to the camera movement

notes.title: Major Updates！
notes.content:
1. Fixed various problems such as players flashing back, reading file crashes, and the game crashes easily.
2. Supported DLSS3 and fixed the localization translation problems except for China.
3. Fixed the problem that some quest punctuation positions are wrong.
4. Increased the third chapter of the plot to skip the function (some of the old graphics card players use the second startup item will lead to the third chapter is very stuck, you can generate switch the first startup item, if not, please press M to skip the plot)
5. Repaired the problem that it is easy to fall into the void from the old home back to school.
6. Fixed the problem that Kidney Treasure will be consumed at the same time, and added the number of Kidney Treasure, players can buy more and use it to exercise.
7. Fixed the problem of getting scholarships stuck
8. Fixed the leaderboard problem
9. Fixed the problem that entering the purchase house will not work.
10. Fixed the problem that the love event can deduct money for repeated conversations.
11. Fixed the problem that some models don't collide.
12. Fixed the problem that love events can be triggered inexplicably.
13. Fixed the problem of not being able to find the monk in the basketball court.
14. Fixed the problem that the director cannot be found in the garden.
15. There are a bunch of micro details and so on, welcome to play again!

notes.content:
[b] Return to campus Officially launched on January 13th!
The store page of the enhanced version of "Campus Fantasy" is released, please make a wish list~[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380110/_/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45189961/21e5fb4606c0fbd53cee6b99af6cf3737e8c9a8a.png[/img]

[b]Dear players,Return to campus will be officially launched on January 13! As mentioned before, Return to campus is completely free. If you like my game, you can add the enhanced version of Campus Fantasy to your wish list. Thank you so much! The following is a comparison between Return to campus and Campus Fantasy:
1.Return to campus has a complete poor child plot. School Dragon will add a rich child plot to the poor child plot
2. Rich children will give extra support to the creative workshop
Although  Return to campus is free, I assure you that the content is still fun. Thank you very much for your continued support. I hope you will like the official version of Return to campus![/b]
